body: A herb here, a tip there.
Scattered pieces rarely add up to change.
A 2,000+ year-old Indian system for staying well, not only treating illness.

slides.foot: Balanced → steady energy. Out of balance → you feel “off.”

list: Wake and sleep at steady times.
Eat your main meal at midday.
Adjust food and routine with the seasons.
slides.foot: Modern lens: consistent sleep and meal timing align with circadian research.

slides.statement: Ayurveda doesn’t add more to your life. It puts what you do in order.

slides.cta: Start with one: a steady wake time, for 3 days.
